```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("writexl")
library(tidyverse)
library (writexl)
```

```{r}
# 1. Load and clean

 df <- readxl::read_excel(
  "~/In_vitro_tests/In_vitro_tests_consortia_secondrun.xlsx",
  sheet = "long"
) %>%
  rename(radius = `Mycelial growth radius (cm)`,
         Rep    = `Experimental Run`) %>%
  mutate( 
      # Standardise treatment names
    Treatment = trimws(Treatment),
    Treatment = recode(Treatment,
      "Cons 1(Pb39+ Pb177)"         = "Cons1 (Pb39+Pb177)",
      "Cons 2 (Pb39+ Pb109)"        = "Cons2 (Pb39+Pb109)",
      "Cons 3 (Pb177+ Pb460)"       = "Cons3 (Pb177+Pb460)",
      "Cons 4(Pb39+ Pb107)"         = "Cons4 (Pb39+Pb107)",
      "Cons 5 (Pb39+ Pb177+ Pb460)" = "Cons5 (Pb39+Pb177+Pb460)",
      "Cons 6( Pb39+ Pb460)"        = "Cons6 (Pb39+Pb460)",
      "Cons 7 (Pb39+ Pb107+ Pb109)" = "Cons7 (Pb39+Pb107+Pb109)",
      "Cons 8 (Pb107+ Pb109)"       = "Cons8 (Pb107+Pb109)",
      "Bacillus sp. Pb109"        = "Bacillus sp. Pb109",
      "Chryseobacterium sp. Pb107" = "Chryseobacterium sp. Pb107",
      "Pseudomonassp. Pb460"        = "Pseudomonas sp. Pb460",
      "Pseudarthobacter sp. Pb177"  = "Pseudarthrobacter sp. Pb177",
      "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"        = "Streptomyces sp. Pb39",
    ),
    Rep   = as.factor(Rep),
    Media = as.factor(Media)
  )

 # 2. AVERAGE TECHNICAL REPLICATES
# ============================================================
df_avg <- df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Media, Rep) %>%
  summarise(radius = mean(radius, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

CALCULATE % INHIBITION vs NEGATIVE CONTROL
```{r}
df_inh <- df_avg %>%
  group_by(Rep, Media) %>%
  mutate(
    neg_radius  = radius[Treatment == "Negative control"],
    inhibition  = (1 - radius / neg_radius) * 100,
    inh_prop    = inhibition / 100          # for beta regression
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Treatment != "Negative control")

# Check for values outside (0,1) for beta
cat("=== Inhibition range ===\n")
print(summary(df_inh$inhibition))
cat("Values <= 0:", sum(df_inh$inh_prop <= 0), "\n")
cat("Values >= 1:", sum(df_inh$inh_prop >= 1), "\n")

# Squish to (0,1) if needed
df_inh <- df_inh %>%
  mutate(inh_prop = pmax(pmin(inh_prop, 0.999), 0.001))

cat("\n=== Mean inhibition by Treatment x Media ===\n")
df_inh %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Media) %>%
  summarise(mean_inh = round(mean(inhibition), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Media, values_from = mean_inh) %>%
  arrange(desc(LB))

# ============================================================
# 4. FIT BETA REGRESSION
# Fixed: Treatment + Media | Random: Rep
# ============================================================
m_beta <- glmmTMB(
  inh_prop ~ Treatment + Media + (1|Rep),
  family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
  data   = df_inh
)

summary(m_beta)
res_beta <- simulateResiduals(m_beta, n = 1000)
plot(res_beta)
```

E means
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. EMMEANS + CLD
# ============================================================
emm_beta <- emmeans(m_beta, ~ Treatment | Media,
                    type = "response")

cld_beta <- multcomp::cld(emm_beta,
                           adjust  = "tukey",
                           Letters = letters,
                           alpha   = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    .group       = trimws(.group),
    inhibition   = response * 100,
    lower.CL     = asymp.LCL * 100,
    upper.CL     = asymp.UCL * 100
  )

print(cld_beta)

# Also get Dunnett contrasts vs negative control
# (already excluded from model, so compare pairwise instead)
contr_beta <- contrast(emm_beta,
                        method = "pairwise",
                        adjust = "tukey")
summary(contr_beta, infer = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 6. PLOT — ordered dot/bar chart faceted by Media
# ============================================================

# Order treatments by mean inhibition across both media
trt_order <- cld_beta %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_inh = mean(inhibition)) %>%
  arrange(mean_inh) %>%
  pull(Treatment)

cld_beta <- cld_beta %>%
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = trt_order))

# Colour: isolates vs consortia
cld_beta <- cld_beta %>%
  mutate(
    type = ifelse(grepl("^Cons", Treatment), "Consortium", "Isolate")
  )

p_invitro2 <- ggplot(cld_beta,
                     aes(x    = inhibition,
                         y    = Treatment,
                         color = type)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.5) +

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL),
                 height    = 0.3,
                 linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_point(size = 3.5) +

  geom_text(aes(x = upper.CL + 1.5, label = .group),
            size = 3.5, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +

  facet_wrap(~ Media, ncol = 2) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Consortium" = "#2166ac",
    "Isolate"    = "#d6604d"
  )) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +

  labs(
    x     = "Mycelial growth inhibition (%)",
    y     = "Treatment",
    color = "Type"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 14, face = "italic"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 16),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray40")
  )

p_invitro2

# Save
ggsave(
  filename    = "Invitro_secondrun_inhibition.tiff",
  plot        = p_invitro2,
  path        = "~/In_vitro_tests",
  width       = 12,
  height      = 8,
  dpi         = 300,
  units       = "in",
  device      = "tiff",
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
